name: The Whispering Wind Chime Tree
description: A massive tree whose branches are adorned with thousands of crystal wind chimes that sing in harmony with the breeze, each note causing nearby flower petals to bloom in synchronized waves.
prompt: A gigantic ancient tree with sprawling branches adorned with thousands of delicate crystal wind chimes of various sizes, each chime glowing softly and producing gentle musical notes when touched by the breeze, causing waves of colorful flower petals to bloom simultaneously in synchronization, soft morning light filtering through the leaves, peaceful and magical garden atmosphere, highly detailed fantasy nature art, serene and harmonious composition
caption: When the wind speaks, every flower answers... 🌸🎶 What secret does the breeze bring you?
